faqs.a: Chaithanya is a solo Indian founder with a team of ten. He builds with AI tools like Claude Code and shares the whole journey — wins and failures — as a weekly founder log.
Several products, built with AI, in public. They'll open on the Products page soon — join the founder log to see them first.

faqs.q: Where do I start on the blog?
faqs.a: Start with Founder log, week 1. Then pick a topic on the Blog page.

faqs.q: How do I get the newsletter?
faqs.a: Sign up on the Newsletter page. One founder log every Saturday — what I tried, what happened, one thing to steal.

faqs.q: When do new videos come out?
faqs.a: A new founder log video comes out every Saturday on YouTube.

faqs.q: Why don't you show your face?
faqs.a: The focus is the build, not the person — screen, voice and story. No face. Just the build.

faqs.q: What AI tools do you use?
faqs.a: Mainly Claude and Claude Code for building, plus automation tools. The AI tools & building posts go deeper.
